comment: The advice to invest first in committees, roles, decision rights, and processes is sensible, but some countries may need basic tooling to make governance feasible where staff capacity is limited and assets are already fragmented.

anchor.note: p.57-58 l.Lines 386-398 read as the printed page; section 3.4.5 agrees

public.text: The advice to invest first in committees, roles, decision rights, and processes is sensible, but some countries may need basic tooling to make governance feasible where staff capacity is limited and assets are already fragmented.
public.suggestedRevision: Reframe this as proportional co-development: establish minimum governance roles and decision rights first, while introducing fit-for-purpose tooling incrementally to support traceability, workflow, versioning, publication, and distribution.
